claim_boundary: Regulatory search coverage, not legal advice and not a full global approved-drug database.

coverage.claim: Trial-search evidence only; absence of a trial is not proof that no program exists.
coverage.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
coverage.plain_use: Checks whether this disease and program have already appeared together in registered studies.

coverage.blocker: Referenced by the partner repo as an MCP requiring CONVOKE_MCP_TOKEN. We do not hold that token and must not hold it in this repo. Credentials live in .env and are never committed. Until someone with access documents the query surface and the license terms of what it returns, Convoke is listed and NOT wired. An undocumented source cannot be admitted, because its results cannot be recomputed by anyone else.
coverage.claim: Not admitted without documented access, license terms, and a replayable query receipt.
coverage.name: Convoke
coverage.plain_use: Would join targets to drug programs if licensed access is available.
